description: Live comparison against the public SRAM AXS tire pressure guide (https://axs.sram.com/guides/tire/pressure), 2026-11-23, MTB Trail, dry, standard casing front and rear, rider weight = kg, bike weight 14 kg. SRAM shows two decimals.

cases.status: BikeLab 4 % lower (26 in wheel, 25 mm rim) — known limit

slope_check: SRAM rider 60→90 kg (bike 11.8 kg, case G1 setup): 1.52, 1.57, 1.61, 1.65, 1.70, 1.74, 1.79 bar front — about +0.044 bar per 5 kg, the same slope as the BikeLab fit
not_checked: XC, enduro and DH cases (G2, G3, G5) and inserts (G8; SRAM has no insert option)
